title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Payoff of a Past-Due Fee Invoice
content:
A creditor client may pay off a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements that is accruing late charges with one payment it makes itself, naming the invoice, on an agreement with no termination notice on record.

## When a payoff figure is quoted

A payoff figure for a past-due invoice is not quoted until the invoice carries a late charge for every full calendar month it has stayed unpaid after its late-charge start.

A full calendar month after a late-charge start runs from that day to the same day of the next month, or to that month's last day where the same day does not exist.

Put the other way: as long as any full calendar month the invoice has stayed unpaid after its late-charge start is without its late charge on that invoice, there is no payoff figure for the invoice.

## Payment instrument: `pay_past_due_invoice_8492adb5`

**Capability.** The creditor client pays off one past-due fee invoice on its contingency placement agreement. One call records one fee payment from the client, dated today and applied to the invoice the client names, and lowers the fees the client owes Ridgeline on the agreement by the amount paid. The client receives a payment confirmation reference it can quote to its accounts-payable team.

**How it is invoked.** This is the client's own instrument: the representative unlocks `pay_past_due_invoice_8492adb5` and hands it over, and the client — the customer themselves — runs it to make the payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the placement agreement reference number (agreement id) of the agreement the invoice belongs to, which the representative reads from the placement agreement lookup and gives to the client | identifier, as the lookup shows it |
| `invoice_number` | the fee invoice number the client names for the payment, exactly as the client reads it from its invoice | verbatim: copied character for character with its letters, digits and hyphen, no change of any kind |
| `payment_amount` | the amount the client pays, as the representative states it | USD, always positive, rounded to the nearest cent (2 decimal places) |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with:

- `entry_id` — the reference of the new client money entry;
- `agreement_id` — the agreement paid on;
- `invoice_number` — the invoice the payment is applied to;
- `entry_type` — always `client_fee_payment_received`;
- `amount` — the amount paid, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_ref` — the payment confirmation reference issued for this payment;
- `entry_date` — today, YYYY-MM-DD;
- `fees_owed_after` — the agreement's fees owed after the payment, USD to 2 decimal places.

Receiving the receipt means the payment is recorded.

## Reference questions

**Which agreements does the payoff cover?** An agreement with no termination notice on record.

**Which invoice is paid?** The past-due fee invoice the client names; the payment is applied to that invoice.

**Who makes the payment?** The client makes it itself, with the instrument handed over to it.
